title: Testing & diagnostics
intro: Technical probes only. Automatic call-to-number attribution and answered-call eligibility are unproven; automatic shortcuts are suppressed.
privacy: Numbers remain in memory and are masked in diagnostics. No messages are sent automatically.
roleWarning: The call-screening role may replace your current screening provider. Continue only if you accept that change in Android’s consent screen. Saved contacts and private calls may not be supplied.
phoneReason: Phone-state permission is used only to observe ringing, off-hook and idle; it does not reveal the number or prove an answered call.
overlayReason: Overlay access permits a temporary, dismissible test shortcut over other apps. It does not guarantee background execution.
testNote: Test-only input: use a consenting tester’s international number with +country code. This is not automatic number-acquisition evidence. Overlay test requires observation running and a fresh idle state. It expires in 15 seconds.
moduleMissing: Native module unavailable. Install a native development build; Expo Go cannot run this prototype.

states.runtime-correlation: Runtime per-call correlation (screening metadata; decided per call)
states.correlated: Session correlated with a single pre-call candidate
states.requested: System consent requested; recheck on return
states.eligibility-unproven: Suppressed: session attribution and participation unproven
states.intent-dispatched: Intent dispatched; chat target needs human verification
states.idle-required: Start observation and wait for idle first
states.error: Action failed; refresh permissions and retry
